s: Dine takshite ishsha ubo k"d seipim: lo tetze ishsha lo bechute tzemer, velo bechute pishtan, velo birtzuot hakkerukin lah al roshah, gezera shemma tizdammen lah tebila beshabbat, veim yihyeh lah hetter latzet bechutin uretzuot ellu — telek bahem gam ken lebet hattebila, vesham titztarek lerappotam shello yihyu mehuddaqim al roshah, shello tehe chatzitza bitbila, veyesh lachush shemma tachletzem legamre meal roshah, veachar hattebila shemma tishkach shehu shabbat utebiem beyadah lebetah, shello tirtzeh lachazor uleqoshram al roshah, ki regilut hu ap bechol lipamim keshecholetzet takshitin qetannim chutz lebetah leezeh tzorek enah maqpedet leolam lachazor ulelobsham, ella noset otam beyadah lipamim ad betah. Abal en regilut kelal laasot ken betakshitin gedolim, kegon chagora vesarbal, shehem meiqqar hammalbush, veenah holeket mimmeqomah ad shettachazor vetilbashem, lepikak en chosheshin shemma tebiem beyadah lebetah achar hattebila. Vaapillu nashim zeqenot sheenan tzerikot litbila (veken habbetulot) — asurot latzet birtzuot vechutin ellu, shello chillequ chakamim bigzeratam ben ishsha leishsha:

Veim hachutin veharetzuot qeluin betok searah — mutteret latzet bahen, sheim tizdammen lah tebila hi zehira lehattir qeliatah mibbeod yom, shebbeshabbat asur lehattir qeliat hassear, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim hachutin hem (chalulim asuyim maaseh reshet) (maaseh ariga), sheenah yekola lemotchan ulehaddeqan bechozqa al roshah, umippene kak hammayim baim bahen veenan chotzetzim — mutteret latzet bahen beshabbat ap sheenan qeluin betok searah. Ubilbad shello yihyu mezohabin, sheaz hi maqpedet alehem shello lelaklekam bemayim, umesiratan mealeha qodem tebila. Veken lo yihyu metunnapot betit, lepi shemmaqpedet gam ken alehem lahasiram qodem tebila, kede shello yimmacheh hattit bammayim veyitnop al besarah baaliyyatah min hattebila:

Mutteret ishsha latzet bechutin hakkerukin betzavvarah, mippene sheen ishsha choneqet atzmah lehaddeqam bechozqa sebib tzavvarah, umin hassetam hem repuyim, veim ken enam chotzetzim, shehammayim baim bahem. Abal beqatla shebbetzavvarah, vehu beged shettola betzavvarah keneged libba, veyesh lo meqom shenatzim keen sheosim lemiknasayim vetochebet bo retzua rechaba veqosheret haretzua sebib tzavvarah — asura latzet bah, lepi shehi choneqet atzmah birtzua zo kede shetteraeh kebaalat basar, shemmittok sheharetzua rechaba enah mazziqatah, vahare zo chatzitza bitbila. Veap im retzua zo repuya al tzavvarah sheenah chotzetzet — asura latzet bebeged zeh im hu chashub umetzuyyar bezahab, gezera shemma tachletzennu mealeha leharot noyo lechabroteha, kederek hannashim shehen shachtzaniyyot umarot takshitehen zo lezo, veachar kak tishkach shehu shabbat utebiennu beyadah d' ammot birshut harabbim:

Veken lo tetze ishsha betotepet, vehu kemin tzitz al mitzchah, umaggia lah meozen leozen. Velo besharbitin, vehu gam ken kemin tzitz shekkorakto al rosha vetola lah al lechayeha mikkan umikkan, ben shehem shel kesep vezahab, ben shehem shel mine tzibonin. Vehu sheenan tepurim lassebaka, sheaz yesh lachush shemma tishlepem leharotah lechabroteha. Abal im hem tepurim lassebaka — en lachush lekak, shevvadday lo tachletzem im hassebaka, shello tegalleh searah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Binsua, abal betula sheenah chosheshet legilluy searah — yesh omerim sheasura latzet bahem ap im hem tepurim bassebaka, shemma tachletzem im hassebaka kede leharot noyah veachar kak tishkach utebiem beyadah:

Lo tetze bekabul, vehu kippa shel tzemer, dehaynu chute tzemer arugim berochab shette etzbaot keshiur tzitz, umannichato sebib paneha letakshit bimqom tzitz, veyesh lachush shemma tishlepennu leharoto:

Lo tetze beitztema, dehaynu matlit shettolin bah chutin shel tzibonin keen gelupeqrin vetolin otah lekalla lehapriach mimmenna hazzebubim, sheim yaamod lah zebub al paneha hi mitbayyesha letordo umitztaeret bo, veen dabar zeh takshit lah kelal, ukemassoy hu. Velaken lo tetze bo ap al pi shehi tzerika lo:

Lo tetze beir shel zahab. Yesh omerim shehu takshit agol umetzayyerin bo tzurat yerushalayim, veyesh bo lashon beemtzao shebbo mechabberin oto lemalbush. Veyesh omerim shehu keen atara al harosh umetzayyerin bo tzurat yerushalayim. (Uleinyan halaka — en baddabar machaloqet kelal, shelledibre hakkol kol takshit sheepshar lah lesholpo uleharoto — asura latzet bo, ben shehu al roshah, ben shehu bemalbushah, vaapillu enah metzuyyar, ella sheddibberu chakamim behoveh bimehem, uparetu kol hattakshitim shehayu bimehem):

Yotzet ishsha biklil shel zahab beroshah, sheen yotzea bah ella ishsha chashuba, sheen darkah lishlop uleharot, velaken lo gazeru al kelil zeh, ben shehu asuy mechatikot shel zahab charuzot bechut, ben sheotan chatikot qebuot bematlit. Abal otan takshitin shekkol hannashim (ashirot) regilot bahem — gazeru alehem ap leishsha chashuba, shello ratzu lechalleq betakshit echad ben ishsha leishsha:

Resoqeya, dehaynu chatikat meil rechaba, im yesh bah retzuot qetzarot teluyot bah leqoshrah bahen ulehaddeqah sebiboteha — mutteret latzet bo, kevan shehu mehuddaq yapeh, veen chosheshin shemma yuttar haqqesher vetippol mealeha. Abal im en bah retzuot — asura latzet bah, shemma tippol mealeha vetishkach utebiennu beyadah:

Lo tetze benizme haap, shemma tishlepem leharotam. Abal yotzet benizme haozen, mippene sheozneha mekussot beqishshureha vetorach hu lah legallotan lishlop mehen hannezamim leharotan. Ubimqomot shennohagin legallot haoznayim — asura latzet gam benizme haozen, velaken habbetulot sheoznehen megullot asurot latzet binzamim:

Derek hannashim lehaamid qishshurehen bimchatin, kegon mapteche chaluqah utzeipah vekayyotze bahen, umutteret latzet bemachat zo min hattora ap al pi sheen aleha shem takshit umalbush kelal, shekkevan shehi meshammeshet lah letzorek lebisha — hare hi kebet yad lehammalbushim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemachat sheenah nequba, abal machat nequba en derek hannashim lehaamid bah qishshurehen, vahare hi massoy gamur, velaken lo tetze bah, veim yatzat — chayyebet. (Veap al pi shehotzia otah al yede qishshureha velo beyadah — en zo hotzaa shello kedarkah, mittaam shennitbaer besimman sh"a). Veap machat sheenah nequba sheroshah echad ab veasuy keen takshit — asura middibre soperim lehaamid bah qishshureha, mishshum gezera shemma tishlepennu leharotah. Veakshav nahagu lehaqel bemachat sheenah nequba sheroshah echad ab, mippene sheeno asuy keen takshit. Vehu shemmaamedet bah qishshureha, abal im enah maamedet bah qishshureha ap shetztzerika lah leezeh tzorek sheyyihyeh, kegon lachaloq bah searah vekayyotze bahen, kevan sheenah meshammeshet lah letzorek lebisha — hare hi massoy gamur kesheen roshah haab asuy keen takshit, sheen adam yakol latzet bekol hachapatzim hatztzerikim lo kesheenan lo malbush velo takshit. Veim hu asuy keen takshit — asur middibre soperim, mishshum gezera:

Tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam — enah takshit leishsha ella massoy gamur, sheen derek hannashim lehitqashshet betabbaat ella kesheen aleha chotam, veim yotza bah — chayyebet. Veen zo hotzaa shello kedarkah, mippene shellipamim noten haish bechol leishto tabbato sheyyesh aleha chotam leholikah labbayit lehatzniah, vehi mesima otah beetzbaa ad shemmaggaat lebetah, venimtza shedderek hotzaa hi ap leishsha lipamim lehotzi beetzbaah tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam, vekevan sheenah takshit lah — chayyebet aleha keshehotziah beshabbat. Abal kesheyyatzat betabbaat sheen aleha chotam — petura, abal asura middibre soperim, mishshum gezera shemma tishlepenna meetzbaah leharotah:

Lo tetze bekuleyar, vehu takshit sheqqosheret bo mapteche chaluqah, velo bekobelet, vehu qesher sheqqashur bah bosem sherecho tob, veishsha sherechah ra toanto aleha, ubeshabbat asura latzet bo, mishshum gezera shemma tishlepem mealeha leharoto:

Im chaser lah shen echad umesima shen acher bimqomah, im hu shel zahab — lo tetze bo, mishshum shehu meshunneh bemarito mishshear hashshinnayim, veshemma yischaqu aleha vetittelennu mishsham beyadah vetishkach utebiennu. Abal im hu shel kesep shehu domeh bemarito lishar hashshinnayim, vekol shekken im hu shen shel adam — mutteret latzet bo:

Lo tetze beminal haqqarua lemala, shemma yischaqu aleha vetachletzennu meal raglah utebiennu beyadah. Velo tetze beminal chadash shello haleka bo adayin, shemma lo yabo lemiddat raglah vetachletzennu utebiennu beyada. Abal im nisseta laleket bo meetmol — kebar hikkira bo shehu mekuvvan lah, o enah maqpedet kelal al zeh. Vekol zeh beishsha, abal ish muttar latzet ben beminal haqqarua ben beminal chadash shello nissa laleket bo meetmol, mippene sheen haish maqpid kol kak al minalayv kemo haishsha shehi shachtzanit. Ushear malbushim shehem qeruim o chadashim — ap haishsha mutteret latzet bahem, lepi shebbidbarim gedolim shehem iqqar hammalbush en chosheshim bahem shettishlepem mealeha, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Yotzet bechute sear hakkerukim lah al sear roshah, sheenan domin lechute tzemer upishtan shemmesiratan meal roshah keshetztzerika litbol mishshum chatzitza, abal chute sear en chotzetzin al sear roshah, mippene shessear besear eno yakol lihyot mehuddaq yapeh shello yabou hammayim benehem, ulekak enah tzerika lahasiram bishat tebila. Vaapillu im chutin ellu hem asuyim missear chabertah sheenah doma bemarito lesear shella, vaapillu hem missear shel behema — en chosheshin shemma yischaqu aleha utesirem beyadah. Ubilbad shello tetze yalda shessaaroteha shechorot bechutin haasuyot missearot shel zeqenot shehen lebanot, velo tetze zeqena bechutin shel sear yalda, mippene sheshshachor al gabbe laban o laban al gabbe shachor hu megunneh veyischaqu aleha utesirem meroshah utebiem beyadah. Abal lo tetze bepea nokrit, dehaynu qeliat sear talush shennotenet al searah kede shetteraeh kebaalat sear harbeh, shemma tachletzenna meal roshah leharota, o shemma tippol meal rosha utebienna beyadah:

Yotzet beqesher sheosin lirpua miqqittup ayin hara shello yishlot, mippene sheqqesher zeh hu keqamea mumcheh shennitbaer besimman sh"a. Veyotzet bemok shebbeoznah shennotenet libloa lecha shel tzoat haozen, vehu shehammok qashur beoznah qesher mehuddaq shello yukal lippol. Veken bemok shebbesandalah, im hu qashur besandalah o baaqebah, mippene shemmok zeh hu lah kemo takshit umalbush, shehare hu meshammesh lahanaat gupah kemo shear malbushim. Ubesandal uminal hassetumim mikkol tzad — muttar apillu en hammok qashur kelal, kevan shei epshar lo lippol mishsham. Abal im hem petuchim apillu mitztzad echad — tzarik leqoshro sham:

Veyotzet bemok shehitqina leniddatah sheyyibbala bo haddam ap al pi sheeno qashur beyarkoteha, sheim yippol lo tebiennu beyadah mechamat meisuto, vaapillu osta lo bet yad. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmesima oto sham kede shello yippol haddam al besarah vitzaarenna kesheyyityabbesh, abal im mesima oto kede shello yetannep haddam et begadeha — asura latzet bo ap al pi sheqqashur lah, kevan sheeno derek malbush, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a:

Veyotzet bepilpel arok shemmesima bepiha lereach happeh, ubegargir melach shemmesima bepiha lirpuat choli hashshinnayim, mippene shehem ketakshitim lah, ubilbad shello tetaqqenem bepiha lekattechilla beshabbat. Vaapillu im netanatam bepiha meereb shabbat venapelu beshabbat — lo tachazirem letok piha, mippene marit haayin, shennireh keillu hi maaremet littenam bepiha kede lehotziah lirshut harabbim, sheen hakkol yodeim lama hi notantam bepiha. Abal mok shebbeoznah veshebbesandalah mutteret leqoshro sham battechilla beshabbat velatzet bo, mippene shennikkar haddabar lamma notenet sham hammok, vehakkol yodeim shehi tzerika lo veenah maaremet kelal. Vehu haddin shemmuttar liqshor qash o teben betok hamminal battechilla beshabbat velatzet bo. Veim hamminal satum mikkol tzad — muttar apillu belo qeshira kemo bemok. Vekol mah shemmuttar beishsha — kol shekken shemmuttar beish:

Yotzet bebatte shoqayim sheqqoshartam bimshicha sebib shoqeha ap al pi sheen hammeshicha qeshura bahem (ella alehem) — en chosheshin shemma yishtalshelu lematta (im hammeshicha shealehem) veyippelu utebiem beyadah:
Yotzet beetzada bizroa o beshoq, vehu shettehe debuqa labbasar, velo tishshamet vetippol utebiah beyadah:

Ap al pi shekkol mah sheaseru chakamim latzet ben leish ben leishsha lo asaruhu ella mechashash shemma kesheyyittelem beyadam yaabirem d' ammot birshut harabbim, o yaknisem mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, kol dabar shehittiru latzet bo mippene sheen shum derek kelal sheyyittelennu beyado — muttar lesholpo velittelo beyad birshut harabbim velachazor ulehitlabbesh bo o lehitqashshet bo qodem sheyyelek d' ammot, ben ish ben ishsha. Veen lanu lachush shemma kesheyyittol beyado yishkach veyaabirennu d' ammot, lepi shei epshar letaqqen chashasha zo, shehare im yishkach shehu shabbat — mah noil kelum im neesor lo lesholpo mealayv birshut harabbim beshabbat, halo hu sabur shehayyom chol, veim yehe zakur keshehu sholepo mealayv shehayyom shabbat — bevadday lo yaabirennu d' ammot beyadayv, veen lachush shemma berega yishkach shehu shabbat veyaabirennu d' ammot. Mah sheen ken bidbarim sheyyesh derek lipamim sheyyittelem beyado, hen mechamat sheyyippelu veyagbihem, hen mechamat sheyyischaqu alayv veyittelem beyad, hen beishsha shettittelem leharoto, hen shettittelem mishshum tebila — aseru chakamim latzet bahem battechilla mibbeto beshaa shezzakur et hashshabbat, mechashash shemma yishkach et hashshabbat kesheyyaggia haet sheyyittelem beyado veyaabirem az d' ammot beshikchato, o yaknisem az mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid:

Kol takshit umalbush sheaseru chakamim latzet bo lirshut harabbim mechashash shemma yebiennu beyado — asur latzet bo lechatzer sheenah meorebet, ben haish ben haishsha. Veen zo gezera ligzera, shehakkol gezera achat hi, shehechatzer sheenah meorebet issur hahotzaa bah domeh beene haam leissur hahotzaa birshut harabbim, veim nattir lahem bechatzer — yattiru leatzman gam birshut harabbim, lepikak kesheggazeru chakamim al reshut harabbim — gazeru gam ken al chatzer sheenah meorebet bekol hattakshitim haasurim birshut harabbim. Chutz mikkabul upea nokrit, shehittiru leishsha bechatzer sheenah meorebet, kede shello titganneh al balah im lo titqashshet kelal gam bechatzer, lepikak hittiru lah miqtzat takshiteha. Abal bechatzer hamorebet muttar latzet apillu bidbarim sheyyesh bahem chiyyub chattat im yetze bahem lirshut harabbim, veen chosheshin shemma yishkach veyetze bahem mechatzer lirshut harabbim. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheapillu betakshitim sheaseru latzet bahem lirshut harabbim mishshum gezera shemma yebiem beyado — asur latzet bahem apillu babbayit, dehaynu sheasur lehitqashshet bahem kelal beshabbat, chutz mikkabul upea nokrit leishsha, gezera shemma yetzeu bahem lirshut harabbim. Veen zo gezera ligzera, shehaddabar qarob levadday shekkesheyyirtzeh latzet lirshut harabbim yishkach lehasir hattakshitin mealayv, shehare bechol en derek kelal lishlop hattakshitin kesheyyotze mibbeto lirshut harabbim. Veen tzarik lomar sheddabar sheyyesh bo chiyyub chattat im yetze bo lirshut harabbim, sheasur lehasim oto alayv babbayit. Velaken asur lehasim ezeh chepetz betok cheqo o bishar meqomot shebbibgadayv beshabbat apillu betok beto, veken litlot mapteach o chepetz acher bachagorato o bishar meqomot shebbibgadayv beinyan sheasur latzet ken lirshut harabbim. Veen hetter letaltel shum chepetz babbayit ella beyado, shebbeyado bevadday en lachush shemma yishkach veyotziah lirshut harabbim, shehare roeh hachepetz beyado, mah sheen ken kesheeno beyado yesh lachush shemma yishkach shehachepetz etzlo kesheyyotze lirshut harabbim. Vaapillu im haya etzlo mibbeod yom — tzarik lahasiro keshettechshak im lo nizkar lahasiro samuk lachasheka, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b. (Vaapillu beir hamorebet sheen bah maqom haasur akshav betiltul — asur). Vaapillu sheyyesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim kelal — en lehaqel baddabar. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara zo im lo beet hatztzorek, sheaz yesh lismok al sebara harishona, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a. Abal yesh meqillin od, sheapillu lechatzer sheenah meorebet muttar latzet bekol hattakshitin sheaseru mishshum gezera shemma yebiem beyado. Veyesh meqillin od lepi zeh latzet bahem ap lekarmelit, ap al pi sheen lah mechitztzot kechatzer sheenah meorebet. Veal pi dibrehem en limchot akshav benashim shellanu hayyotzeot bekol mine takshitim, lepi sheyyesh omerim shebbizman hazzeh en lanu reshut harabbim kelal ella karmelit. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut acher, shello aseru hattakshitin ella bimehem shello hayu hattakshitin metzuyin kol kak larob, velo hayu mitqashshetot bahem ki im beshabbat, velaken haya debar chiddush beenehen vehayu marot zo lezo, mah sheen ken bizman hazzeh shemmetzuyin takshitin larob veyotzet bahen gam bechol, veenan debar chiddush beshabbat shettareh otam lechabroteha. Veen hetter zeh moil ella letakshitim sheaseru mechashash shemma tishlepem leharotam, abal takshitim sheaseru mechashash shemma yippelu o mechashash tebila o shemma yischaqu aleha vetittelem beyada — en lanu lomar ella shessomekot al dibre hammeqillin shennitbaer. Abal kol haddebarim sheasur latzet bahem min hattora mippene shehem massoy gamur — asur ledibre hakkol latzet bahem apillu lekarmelit. (Vaapillu im motzi otam haddebarim beinyan sheen bahem issur min hattora ap lirshut harabbim mechamat shehi hotzaa shello kedarkah, mikkol maqom kevan shehem massoy velo takshit — lo hittirum legamre apillu bechatzer sheenah meorebet, ella hare hem kishar shebut dishbut shello hittiru ella bimqom mitzva o hepsed merubbeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z). Ulepikak haya rauy limchot benashim shello tetzena betabbaot sheyyesh alehem chotam, ubaanashim shello yetzeu betabbaot sheen alehem chotam, shehare hen massoy gamur lahen, ella sheen limchot benashim, shekkevan shello yishmeu — mutab sheyyihyu shogegot veal yihyyav mezidot. Viyesh me shellimmed zekut al anashim, shekkevan shennahagu haanashim bizman hazzeh latzet bechol betabbaot sheen alehem chotam — hare naasu lahem ketakshit, umuttar latzet bahen lepi dibre hammeqillin betakshitim gam lenashim. Abal lepi dibre haoserim benashim — gam anashim asurim latzet betabbaat zo shehi takshit leish uleishsha, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a. Ulepi hetter zeh yesh lilmod hetter gam lenashim betabbaot sheyyesh alehen chotam, shekkevan shebbizman hazzeh nahagu hannashim latzet bechol gam betabbaot sheyyesh alehen chotam — hare naasu lahen takshit, umuttarin latzet bahem beshabbat lepi dibre hammeqillin. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lehazhir lenashim shello tetzena ella bimchatin shetztzerikot lehaamid bahen qishshurehen velo yoter, ki bezeh sheen lahem toelet bo yishmeu lanu. Vekol zeh leinyan lehazhir limchot benashim o baanashim, abal kol adam yesh lo lehachamir al atzmo kisbara hashsheniyya shennitbaer lemala, ubeet hatztzorek yismok al sebara harishona shennitbaer lemala:

Machat sheenah nequba shennittal uqtzah, dehaynu haqqesher shellah shebberoshah haab, vegam nittal chod shellah — en aleha torat keli kelal, veasur letaltelah beshabbat, vetzarik lehazhir lenashim shello yetalteluha lasum bitzipim. Ella im ken nittal chuddah veuqtzah meereb shabbat (veyichada otah) leshem kak (mibbeod yom), sheal yede (yichud maaseh) zeh shemmibbeod yom — naaset keli leinyan zeh. Veken machat nequba shennittal chuddah vechorah (veyichada otah) mibbeod yom lasum ota betzaip — muttar lasum otah betzaip beshabbat velatzet bah gam ken: (chaser)
